definitions.explanation: An automatic machine that dispenses items such as drinks, snacks, or tickets when money is inserted. This is a shortened form of {自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}.

examples.japanese: {自販機|じはんき}で{飲|の}み{物|もの}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a drink from the vending machine.

examples.japanese: この{自販機|じはんき}は{電子|でんし}マネーが{使|つか}える。
examples.english: This vending machine accepts electronic money.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{自販機|じはんき}の{数|かず}が{世界一|せかいいち}{多|おお}いと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Japan is said to have the most vending machines in the world.

notes:
{自販機|じはんき} is the commonly used abbreviation for {自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自販機|じはんき}で{買|か}う (to buy from a vending machine)
- {飲|の}み{物|もの}の{自販機|じはんき} (drink vending machine)
- {自販機|じはんき}コーナー (vending machine area)

USAGE:
- Japan is famous for its abundant vending machines
- Available for drinks, snacks, cigarettes, tickets, etc.
- Most accept IC cards like Suica

RELATED WORDS:
- {自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}: vending machine (full form)
- {券売機|けんばいき}: ticket machine
